notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #1 – Thank You & Fixes!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed some bugs and made a few improvements.

[b]Patch Notes - Update #1:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where blink events wouldn't trigger when eyes were nearly closed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the screen to stay black after the intro cutscene if the game lost focus.[/p][/*][*][p]The drawer open sound effect is now properly audible.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced the doctor's voice volume during the tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all the support and feedback![/p][p]If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to [url="https://discord.gg/s2rKGd2a"]join our Discord[/url] and let us know.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
